title: genista repens
intro: Genista repens, commonly known as creeping broom or broom loveplant, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub in the legume family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the treatment of anxiety, insomnia, and other nervous system disorders. The therapeutic actions of Genista repens are attributed to its ability to stimulate the nervous system, increase alertness, and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, including genistein, a plant-based compound with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
